sync.pickFacility: Pick a facility to attach the Scope 3 row to

drawer.title: Add PCAF asset
drawer.intro: Choose the PCAF asset class that matches the holding. Each one has its own attribution rule.

grid.emptyBefore: No assets match your filter. Click
grid.title: Portfolio
grid.deleteBody: The asset and its financed emissions are removed from this reporting year. Synced Scope 3 rows are not changed.

listed_equity.label: Listed equity
listed_equity.name: Listed Equity & Corporate Bonds
listed_equity.description: PCAF Standard A. Attribution factor = outstanding investment value / company EVIC. Use reported emissions where available; fall back to sector intensity × revenue proxy.

evic.label: Counterparty EVIC
evic.help: Enterprise Value Including Cash. Leave blank to estimate (lower data quality).

corporate_bond.label: Corporate bonds
corporate_bond.name: Corporate Bonds
corporate_bond.description: PCAF Standard A. Same EVIC-based attribution as listed equity, applied to held bond face value.

evic.label: Issuer EVIC
evic.help: Enterprise Value Including Cash of the issuer.

business_loan.label: Business loans
business_loan.name: Business Loans
business_loan.description: PCAF Standard B. Attribution = outstanding loan / (borrower equity + debt). Use reported emissions where available; otherwise estimate from sector intensity × revenue.

unlisted_equity.label: Unlisted equity
unlisted_equity.name: Unlisted / Private Equity
unlisted_equity.description: PCAF Standard B. Attribution = investment / (investee equity + debt). Use reported emissions where available; otherwise estimate from sector intensity.

project_finance.label: Project finance
project_finance.name: Project Finance
project_finance.description: PCAF Standard C. Attribution = loan amount / (project equity + project debt). Uses project-level annual emissions where available.

commercial_real_estate.label: Commercial real estate
commercial_real_estate.name: Commercial Real Estate
commercial_real_estate.description: PCAF Standard D. Financed emissions = building annual emissions × (loan / property value). Prefer measured energy; fall back to certificates, then floor-area × type intensity.

measuredAnnualEmissions.label: Measured annual emissions
measuredAnnualEmissions.help: From utility bills or energy certificate (DQ ≤ 2).

mortgage.label: Mortgages
mortgage.name: Residential Mortgages
mortgage.description: PCAF Standard E. Financed emissions = (floor area × country residential intensity) × (loan / property value).

motor_vehicle_loan.label: Motor vehicle loans
motor_vehicle_loan.name: Motor Vehicle Loans
motor_vehicle_loan.description: PCAF Standard F. Financed emissions = annual vehicle emissions × (loan / vehicle value). Prefer measured odometer × EF, fall back to fleet averages.

annualDistanceKm.label: Annual distance driven
annualDistanceKm.help: Used to compute emissions when measured value not available.

sovereign_debt.label: Sovereign debt
sovereign_debt.name: Sovereign Debt
sovereign_debt.description: PCAF Standard G. Financed emissions = country emissions × (investment / country GDP-PPP).

gdpPppMillions.label: Country GDP-PPP
gdpPppMillions.help: GDP in PPP terms (USD millions). Used as the denominator.

reportedCountryEmissionsMt.label: Country annual emissions
reportedCountryEmissionsMt.help: From NDC inventory if available; else uses country-emissions-per-GDP table.

warnings.evicEstimatedIssuer: EVIC estimated — supply issuer EVIC for higher data quality
warnings.evicEstimated: EVIC estimated — provide actual EVIC for higher data quality
warnings.sectorIssuer: Emissions estimated from sector intensity — replace with issuer disclosure for DQ ≤3
warnings.sectorBorrower: Emissions estimated from sector intensity — request borrower disclosure for DQ ≤3
warnings.sectorCounterparty: Emissions estimated from sector intensity — replace with counterparty disclosure for DQ ≤3
warnings.borrowerValueUnknown: Borrower equity + debt unknown — using loan × 8 proxy. Provide actual balance-sheet figures for DQ ≤3.
warnings.investeeValueUnknown: Investee equity + debt unknown — using investment × 8 proxy
warnings.creValueMissing: Property value missing — using loan × 1.4 proxy (assumes ~70% LTV)
warnings.creFloorArea: Floor-area intensity estimate — provide measured energy data for DQ ≤2
warnings.creNoData: Provide measured emissions or floor area + building type
warnings.totalValueMissing: Total value missing or zero — attribution set to 0; provide enterprise value or property value
warnings.attrCapped: Attribution factor {{value}} >1.5 capped to 1.5 — outstanding may exceed total value
warnings.attrNegative: Attribution factor negative — outstanding/total_value must be ≥0
warnings.vehicleValueMissing: Vehicle value missing — using loan × 1.15 proxy
warnings.distanceUnknown: Annual distance unknown — using fleet average for drivetrain
warnings.projectStackUnknown: Project capital stack unknown — using loan × 1.3 proxy
warnings.projectTypeEstimate: Project emissions estimated from project-type intensity
warnings.mortgageValueMissing: Property value missing — using loan × 1.25 proxy (~80% LTV)
warnings.householdEstimate: Household emissions estimated from country residential intensity
warnings.floorAreaMissing: Floor area missing — using typical 100 m² household
warnings.gdpMissing: GDP-PPP missing — using outstanding as denominator (attribution will be ~1, expect low DQ)
warnings.countryEstimate: Country emissions estimated from per-GDP intensity table — replace with NDC inventory data

rationale.sectorEstRevenue: Sector intensity ({{intensity}} kgCO2e/USD revenue, {{sector}}) × est. revenue × attribution
rationale.sectorEstRevenueNoSector: Sector intensity ({{intensity}} kgCO2e/USD revenue) × est. revenue × attribution
rationale.sectorRevenueProxy: Sector intensity ({{intensity}} kgCO2e/USD, {{sector}}) × revenue proxy × attribution
rationale.noData: No measured emissions, no floor area — cannot compute building emissions
rationale.projectType: Project-type intensity ({{intensity}} kgCO2e/USD, {{type}}) × project value × attribution

dq.title: Data quality profile
dq.subtitle: Share of outstanding by PCAF score
dq.footnote: PCAF scores run from 1 (best) to 5. Aim to move outstanding towards DQ 1–2.
